decisions.reason: Adjustable quarter-pallet display remains close to the core offer and shows no negative performance signals.
Pegboard-back display is a standard cardboard variant that fits the established range.
Eighth-pallet display adds size flexibility within the core cardboard line.
Wooden pallet deviates from the paper-based core and has weak strategic fit.
Media-specific quarter-pallet is a narrow niche with limited demand potential.
